biggest_catch: Only the first referrer to enter a given person gets paid; the $100 referrer card is paid per referral (personal or business) while the $200 figure is the referred business's own reward.
catches: Referrer earns $100 per referral (personal or business); the $200 Mastercard Reward Card in the business section is the referred business's reward, not yours.
Referrer must register for the program and submit a valid email address for both themselves and each referred person.
Only the first referrer to enter information for a given referred person is eligible for that person's reward.
Friend must not already have a First Commonwealth Bank checking account (minor-account exceptions apply).
Personal track: friend must open a new personal checking account and, within 60 days of opening, complete one direct deposit of $250+ OR 10 qualifying debit card purchases.
Business track: referred business must open a new business checking account and complete at least $2,000 in qualifying deposits within 60 days.
A referrer may receive up to five (5) Reward Cards ($500 value) within a calendar year.
Reward cards are mailed 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed; the bonus may be reported as income to the IRS.
The program may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice.

steps: Register for the First Commonwealth Bank referral program and agree to the Terms and Conditions.
Submit valid email addresses for yourself and each person or business you refer.
The referred person registers via your referral link or social media and opens a new First Commonwealth personal or business checking account.
Personal: friend completes a $250+ direct deposit or 10 qualifying debit purchases within 60 days of opening. Business: referred business completes $2,000+ qualifying deposits within 60 days.
timing: Mastercard Reward Cards are mailed to the referrer's address 4-6 weeks after the referred person completes all requirements; the friend must complete qualifying activity within 60 days of account opening.
